combos.label: Spotlight search
combos.note: macOS opens Spotlight; Keebind will usually not receive this combo.

combos.label: Application switcher
combos.note: Reserved by macOS; cannot be reliably overridden.

combos.label: Toggle full screen
combos.note: Standard full-screen toggle in most Mac apps.

combos.label: Quit application
combos.note: Standard quit shortcut in virtually every Mac app; binding it globally will shadow it.

combos.label: Close window/tab
combos.note: Standard close shortcut in virtually every Mac app.

keyNotes.label: Function row default: brightness down
keyNotes.note: On Mac keyboards F1–F12 default to media/system functions. A plain F-key binding only fires with Fn held, or with "Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys" enabled in System Settings → Keyboard.

keyNotes.label: Function row default: brightness up
keyNotes.note: See F1 note: media function unless standard function keys are enabled or Fn is held.

keyNotes.label: Show Desktop / volume down
keyNotes.note: macOS maps F11 to Show Desktop (and volume down on the media row). Check System Settings → Desktop & Dock / Keyboard shortcuts before binding it.

keyNotes.label: Function row default: volume up
keyNotes.note: Historically also Dashboard. See F1 note about media functions.

keyNotes.label: Free on modern macOS
keyNotes.note: Unassigned by default — a good remap target. Historical caveat: on Windows-layout keyboards F13 occupies the Print Screen position and a few apps treat it as PrtScn.

keyNotes.label: Usually free; brightness on some hardware
keyNotes.note: Unassigned by macOS, but some external displays and older Apple keyboards use F14 for brightness down at the hardware level.

keyNotes.label: Usually free; brightness on some hardware
keyNotes.note: Unassigned by macOS, but some external displays and older Apple keyboards use F15 for brightness up at the hardware level.

keyNotes.label: Free — ideal remap target
keyNotes.note: Unassigned by macOS. Ideal for macropads and custom bindings.

keyNotes.note: Unassigned by macOS. Ideal for macropads and custom bindings. F19 is the last key on Apple's full-size keyboards.

keyNotes.label: Free; not present on Apple keyboards
keyNotes.note: macOS recognizes F20 but no Apple keyboard has it — perfect for programmable boards that can emit it.

keyNotes.label: May not be delivered by macOS
keyNotes.note: macOS support for F21–F24 is inconsistent; many boards' F21–F24 keypresses never reach apps. Verify with the Key Listener before relying on it.
